select_wna16_moe_backend: select the WNA16 MoE backend for a given FusedMoE config, weight key, and weight bits
build_wna16_moe_kernel: build a WNA16 MoE kernel from quant config, moe config, experts class, and layer parameters
convert_wna16_moe_kernel_format: convert WNA16 MoE weights to the kernel format for a selected backend
backend_to_kernel_cls: map a WNA16MoEBackend enum value to its corresponding FusedMoEExperts class
process_weights_marlin: post-process Marlin WNA16 MoE weights including FP8 preprocessing, g_idx sorting, repacking, and scale permutation
